whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Zayka Chicken Biryani,

I noticed your restaurant has solid 4.1★ reviews on Khagaul Road in Phulwari Sharif, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online biryani orders and table inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, signature menu showcase, aur Google Maps location integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://zayka-chicken-biryani-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Zayka Chicken Biryani, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your location near Phulwari Sharif Golamber. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu prices, actual food photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
